Show the OmniPhenoR implementation blocks

Source: R/core.R
pheno_blocks.Rd

Version 1.0.0 consolidates 240 implementation blocks across five development generations: classical phenotyping (0.1.0), R-native deep learning (0.2.0), external computer-vision interoperability (0.3.0), longitudinal phenotyping (0.4.0), and experiment/data infrastructure with MIAPPE, BrAPI, FAIR, provenance, and portable research bundles (0.5.0).

Usage

pheno_blocks(pattern = NULL)

Arguments

pattern

Optional regular expression applied to module and function.

Value

A tibble describing the implementation registry.

Examples

pheno_blocks()
#> # A tibble: 240 × 5
#>    block module              primary_function      introduced status     
#>    <int> <chr>               <chr>                 <chr>      <chr>      
#>  1     1 Project object      pheno_project         0.1.0      implemented
#>  2     2 Capability registry pheno_capabilities    0.1.0      implemented
#>  3     3 Teaching data       pheno_data            0.1.0      implemented
#>  4     4 Image ingestion     pheno_read            0.1.0      implemented
#>  5     5 Scale calibration   pheno_calibrate_scale 0.1.0      implemented
#>  6     6 RGB calibration     pheno_calibrate_rgb   0.1.0      implemented
#>  7     7 RGB index catalog   pheno_rgb_catalog     0.1.0      implemented
#>  8     8 RGB index engine    pheno_rgb_indices     0.1.0      implemented
#>  9     9 Index segmentation  pheno_segment         0.1.0      implemented
#> 10    10 Otsu segmentation   pheno_segment         0.1.0      implemented
#> # ℹ 230 more rows
